articles.title: Peer AI Appoints David Florez as Vice President of Sales
articles.mainIdea: Peer AI Appoints David Florez as Vice President of Sales
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Peer AI Appoints David Florez as Vice President of Sales. Peer AI, a leading agentic AI platform for life sciences regulatory documentation, today announced the appointment of David Florez as vice president of sales. Florez will lead go-to-market strategy, drive adoption of AI for regulatory intelligence, and focus on building deeper customer relationships to ensure successful change management as life sciences organizations transform document-intensive regulatory workflows.
